description: Check any wallet (EVM 0x address or Solana base58, case-sensitive) before paying it or taking its money: OFAC SDN list on both families; on Solana also the issuer freeze of USDC and EURC (Circle), USDT (Tether), PYUSD and USDG (Paxos) and USD1 (World Liberty), the issuer freeze index, and a fund trail up to three hops back. Returns verdict passed, blocked or unavailable, with each check. Paying an invoice (invoice_pay) runs this check on the receiving wallet and refuses with receiver_blocked, so a payment through Vurto Payments never reaches a sanctioned or frozen wallet. To pay someone directly, create an invoice to their wallet (invoice_create) and pay it with invoice_pay. Plain swaps (swap_build, double_build, nn_build) do not run it. The Scorechain and Merkle Science checks are paid and run only inside an invoice whose analysis was paid; asking for them here returns paid_check_requires_invoice (400).

chainId.description: The network that will pay, to read the wallet on it: the answer gets network.state (verified, no_activity, contract, not_a_wallet, invalid, unread). Solana addresses are read without it.

checks.description: Kept for compatibility; leave it out. Every extra check is paid since 22/10/2026 (since 11/11/2026 by the bracket fee of the amount, https://docs.vurto.cc/fees) and runs only inside an invoice whose analysis was paid (invoice_create with checks, then invoice_analysis_pay): here any of them is refused with paid_check_requires_invoice (400), so the paid analysis never becomes a free lookup. Any other value is refused with invalid_check.

wallet.description: The wallet to check. EVM 0x address, or Solana base58 (case-sensitive).

name: wallet_check
